scope: Prepared only. Root will replace the two repository collectors after the running old6a batch ends.
helperNote: browser.mjs is an unchanged byte-copy for safe --help import, not a modified collector/helper to replace.
changes: Initial wait retains __bench/enterBtn readiness and additionally waits for existing Sphere dome.mesh.visible=true. It never writes visible and never invokes compile or a forced seek/clock.

Install finite onAfterRender counters only around the same WARMUP frames. Original callbacks receive the same this/args and their return value is preserved. Count all submissions and main camera submissions separately.
Finally restore the original callbacks before program inspection and before CDP metricsBefore/measured sampling. Unexpected hook replacement is explicit unverified evidence.

After warmup, inspect only actually used dome materials: currentProgram, isReady, LINK_STATUS, diagnostics.runnable, optional failure log. A pending program is not forced through a blocking LINK_STATUS query.

Base main-camera draw is required in Sphere. An active two-pass overlay requires its own main-camera draw. Old single-pass has explicit no-overlay status. An inactive overlay program remains NOT_USED_IN_WARMUP.
Missing/pending/failed program evidence returns UNVERIFIED and the run fails before collection. Hall returns NOT_APPLICABLE and remains executable through the common collector.
Hidden dome before or after a step throws. These two guards are outside the existing completeMs/submitMs timestamp window.

result.initialReadiness and scenarios[name].domeReadiness retain the observed gate/status, draw counts, uniforms, programs, and failure reasons. Warmup readiness remains in the raw JSON if subsequent checks fail.

measurementMeaning.fixedQualityTimedSegment: Existing frame()+optional readPixels timestamp segment is byte-identical. No draw counter or shader/program query remains installed inside measured frame().
measurementMeaning.unchangedFixture: Same piece, synthetic audio/visual time, camera/viewport/FOV, seeds, audience, world transition time, effects, preset and number of warmup/sample steps. Initial UI gate now waits longer when the dome is still hidden.
measurementMeaning.cadenceCaveat: Native rAF interval still includes ordinary collector overhead; the new small visibility guards are outside the frame timing window but may contribute to cadence callback overhead. No timing subtraction or clock adjustment was added.
measurementMeaning.automaticCaveat: Extra out-of-window readiness calls may affect wall-clock elapsed before the first automatic-quality frame. Existing auto real-interval policy is deliberately not reset or manipulated. Use the same prepared collector on both revisions and retain this limitation.
measurementMeaning.counterLimit: onAfterRender proves a submission path, not that dome pixels passed depth or are visually correct. Link and readiness are not GPU frame-time or visual-fidelity measurements.
measurementMeaning.programScope: Only base and used overlay current programs are inspected. World cube shader programs are not separately attributed by this probe; existing whole-frame stats/diagnostics and actual new visual runs remain necessary.
measurementMeaning.notValidation: Syntax/help and static byte comparisons passed. Actual prepared collector execution in browser remains untested; do not label the new readiness paths browser-PASS until root runs them.
